calls.reasoning: Reference class: Trump's attendance at the annual November UFC card at MSG. He went 3 for 3 (UFC 281, 295, 309) before his second term, then skipped UFC 322 in Nov 2025 as sitting president, reportedly over Epstein-email scrutiny and fear of a hostile crowd after being booed at an NFL game. In his second term he attends roughly 2 UFC cards a year (UFC 314, 316 in 2025; UFC 327 and the White House card in 2026), so the chance of any given card is low, though high-profile cards draw him more. Factors for Yes: Polymarket sponsorship ties to his circle, a heavyweight title fight. Factors for No: no announcement found as of Oct 25, a likely hostile NYC crowd, the event falls just after the midterms, and he skipped the same MSG card last year. No market found.

- Searched for and did NOT find: any announcement or report (as of 2026-10-25) that Trump plans to attend or skip UFC 334; any Trump UFC attendance between July and October 2026; any Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market on this specific question.
- Status quo: no presidential attendance unless he decides to go; this kind of decision is often announced only days before.
- Resolution: resolves off Trump being physically on the grounds of the UFC 334 venue (MSG) before Nov 15, 2026 NYC time; No if the event does not happen.
- Event window: effectively the single night of Nov 14, 2026 (criteria: any time before Nov 15, 2026). As of 2026-10-25, the event is 20 days away; it is a single-day event, so none of it has happened yet.

calls.reconciliation: Factual checks: (1) Whether any attendance plan has been reported: a search turned up nothing as of Oct 25, so all runs were right that there is no announcement. (2) The Kalshi UFC 334 price: the page returned HTTP 429, still unknown. (3) Run 2's claim of a Kalshi 2% price for UFC 333: the search snippet confirms it as of Oct 25. (4) A snippet suggesting about 82% for UFC 332 looked garbled. The Wikipedia page for UFC 332 (Oct 3, Salt Lake City) mentions no Trump attendance, so I treat it as a skip. Since June he appears to have skipped UFC 330, 332 and 333. The remaining dispute is judgment: how much weight MSG and his home city get against last year's MSG skip and his recent low attendance. Runs 1 and 3 lean on his pre-2025 MSG record, but his only MSG card as second-term president was a skip. Run 2's general base rate of about 15% under-weights the MSG/home-city and post-midterm factors. I land at 0.17.
